status: proposed; not run; Phase 4 input from packet S8 (warp markers and settings)
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin the Live executable and preferences hash before the sitting; fresh preferences; record the Default Warp Mode preference value

Base input: Chuck Sutton - Patience (Live 12 Suite Demo).als (App-Resources/Core Library/Lessons/Demo Songs, SHA-256 3f1c0f924b750c2adba2525838f2bc00856e52faea09d43b9279c6a0fe40952b), first AudioClip 'Vocal Main' (markers (0,0),(0.0112275449101796407,0.03125), WarpMode 4); decompress, edit only the stated elements, recompress with gzip
Retain every input file, its SHA-256, Log.txt, a screen capture of the Clip View warp area (Seg. BPM, Warp Mode, mode settings, markers) and any re-saved file
Disable Link, external sync and tempo follower; no MIDI mappings

probes.question: Does an AudioClip with an empty WarpMarkers list stop the set from opening, and with what message?
probes.existing_evidence: AAudioClip post-load 0x1027c1c7c: empty list -> 'Empty warp marker array.' -> 0x101488e64 -> 0x10148229c (s8-0001, s8-0003)
probes.why_static_insufficient: The top-level catch and user-visible outcome were not traced; whether the post-load hook runs for every set load (context flag +0x2c) is unknown
probes.minimal_input: Base input with the Vocal Main <WarpMarkers> emptied (<WarpMarkers />)
probes.discriminating_observation: Error dialog and set not opened, versus set opens (and what markers the clip shows)

probes.question: What does a single-marker AudioClip load as (segment tempo, Seg. BPM display, re-saved markers)?
probes.existing_evidence: Post-load requires >= 1 marker only; segment and minimum-tempo helpers return -60 / DBL_MAX for degenerate lists (0x10261093c, 0x10261097c)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Clip tempo derivation for one marker was not traced
probes.minimal_input: Base input, Vocal Main WarpMarkers reduced to <WarpMarker Id="10" SecTime="0" BeatTime="0" />
probes.discriminating_observation: Opens or not; Seg. BPM shown; marker list after re-save (shadow added or not)
probes.stopping_condition: One open and one re-save captured; stop

probes.question: Are out-of-order or duplicate markers rejected, sorted, or kept in document order?
probes.existing_evidence: No sort or order check found on the load path; 0x1027b7cf0 and 0x1027c79d0 walk markers assuming ascending order; API add enforces ordering (0x1033bf42c)
probes.why_static_insufficient: RemoteableList child loading order was not traced
probes.minimal_input: Base input variants: (a) Vocal Main markers in reverse order; (b) a three-marker list whose middle marker has BeatTime below the first; (c) two markers with equal SecTime
probes.discriminating_observation: Error vs open; marker positions shown; order and values after re-save

probes.question: What happens when a WarpMarker lacks SecTime or BeatTime, or carries 'Invalid'?
probes.existing_evidence: AWarpMarker ctor sets both to DBL_MAX (0x1026105ec); loader stores attributes directly (n1 0x101487310); DBL_MAX is written as 'Invalid' (n1 writer)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Downstream use of DBL_MAX positions was not traced
probes.minimal_input: Base input variants: second Vocal Main marker without BeatTime; same with BeatTime="Invalid"
probes.discriminating_observation: Error vs open; Seg. BPM; re-saved attribute text

probes.question: How are WarpMode codes 5 (REX on a WAV), 7 and -1 handled on load, display and re-save?
probes.existing_evidence: Stored list has 7 entries (0x1026a9ef8); loader stores the enum index directly (n1); ARemoteableEnum setter range check is not on the load path
probes.why_static_insufficient: Effective warper selection for an invalid index and the re-saved value are unknown
probes.discriminating_observation: Error vs open; Warp Mode chooser text; audible mode; re-saved value

probes.question: Are mode settings outside their constructor ranges clamped on load or on save?
probes.existing_evidence: Ranges from 0x1027b0e40 getters (getter-constants.txt); loader stores directly
probes.why_static_insufficient: Clamp behaviour of later reads/writes was not traced; TransientEnvelope range anomaly (0, 1.0, 100)
probes.minimal_input: Base input, Vocal Main: GranularityTones 5 and 500; GranularityTexture 300; FluctuationTexture -10; TransientEnvelope 150; ComplexProFormants 200; ComplexProEnvelope 4 and 300 and 100.5
probes.discriminating_observation: Values shown in Clip View (after selecting the matching Warp Mode) and re-saved text
probes.stopping_condition: One set with all edits, one re-save; stop

probes.question: Does Live keep a trailing marker spacing other than 1/32 beat, and does it re-normalise it on edit or save?
probes.existing_evidence: Shadow placement +0.03125 beat (0x102612464, 0x102610bc4, 0x1027d304c); shipped exceptions at 1/16 and 1/64 beat (static-survey notable.last_step_not_1/32)
probes.minimal_input: Base input, Vocal Main second marker BeatTime="0.0625" SecTime="0.022455089820359281" (same 167 BPM)
probes.discriminating_observation: Re-saved markers unchanged vs moved to 0.03125; Seg. BPM
probes.stopping_condition: One open, one re-save, one re-save after nudging a marker; stop

probes.question: Is warped playback position piecewise linear in markers, extrapolated with the first and last segment slopes?
probes.existing_evidence: Segment tempo 0x10261093c; shadow construction; 1 ms collinearity test 0x1027c724c; shipped OutMarker = extrapolated end beat 292/399, HiddenLoopStart = back-extrapolated start 330/399
probes.why_static_insufficient: The engine-side or API conversion routine was not located
probes.minimal_input: A 4-second 48 kHz WAV with short clicks every 0.5 s; one warped clip (Re-Pitch, then Beats) with markers (SecTime, BeatTime) (0,0), (1.0,2), (2.0,3) and shadow (2.015625,3.03125), i.e. segments of 120 and 60 BPM and 120 BPM after the last marker; first marker moved to (0.5,1) in a second variant to expose the region before it; song tempo 120; render 8 beats
probes.discriminating_observation: Click times in the render match the piecewise-linear prediction within one sample per click; clicks before the first and after the last marker follow the predicted extrapolation
probes.stopping_condition: Two renders measured; stop (algorithm output quality is out of scope)

probes.question: For an unwarped AudioClip, are LoopStart/LoopEnd/HiddenLoop*/OutMarker interpreted in seconds of sample time?
probes.existing_evidence: Shipped unwarped clips: LoopEnd = HiddenLoopEnd = DefaultDuration/DefaultSampleRate 2479/2479; OutMarker matches seconds 1866, seconds x set tempo/60 432, other 181
probes.why_static_insufficient: OutMarker semantics differ in shipped files; the reader path was not traced
probes.minimal_input: Recording Audio.als (SHA-256 af57ff8f…c043) with one unwarped clip of a known-length WAV; variants LoopEnd half the length, OutMarker half the length
probes.discriminating_observation: Clip end/loop brace positions in seconds in the Clip View; played length

probes.question: What defaults apply when warp setting elements are absent, and does the Default Warp Mode preference feed WarpMode?
probes.existing_evidence: AAudioClip ctor 0x1027b0e40 defaults (WarpMode = pref-mapped or 0; TransientResolution 6; TransientLoopMode 2; Tones 30; Texture 65; Fluctuation 25; Envelope 100; Formants 100; ComplexProEnvelope 128); pref map 0x105889f90 = 0,1,2,3,4,6
probes.why_static_insufficient: Construction order relative to load and the preference object (0x101849958) were not traced
probes.minimal_input: Base input, Vocal Main with WarpMode and the eight setting elements deleted; run twice with Default Warp Mode = Beats and = Complex Pro

probes.question: Per warp mode, how does audio output compare with a candidate for fixed markers and settings?
probes.existing_evidence: Engine classes OWarperBeats, OWarperTones, OWarperTexture, OWarperRePitch, OWarperElastique, OWarperRex, OWarperUnWarped (symbols-warp.txt); no algorithm traced
probes.why_static_insufficient: Stretching algorithms are out of scope for this packet and need measured comparison
probes.minimal_input: Same WAV and markers as PRB-S8-08; one render per WarpMode 0-4 and 6 with shipped default settings
probes.discriminating_observation: Renders retained for later candidate comparison under declared metrics (Q-001)
